answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to lock a refundable stake bond before trading, like copper coins held in escrow from dawn until a deal settles. One honest agent locks one bond; a forger aiming for a thousand fake identities must fund a thousand, and fraud proven against any identity slashes its bond to its nadir, zero. Fakery thus costs real capital per identity, while honest agents get their stake back.
